verdict.rationale: Superset's own CLI is documented for use "from CI" to manage workspaces, tasks and automations. Its MCP server, SDK and API can programmatically launch agents with a prompt, so a pipeline step can start an agent session. There is no documented CI-specific integration (e.g., a pipeline action or a trigger on build/test failure) and no example of an agent fixing a failing build. missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration or failure-triggered agent runs, a worked example of fixing broken builds or tests from a pipeline, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an agent from CI/CD pipelines to fix a broken build or failing test

citations.quote: Use it to manage workspaces, tasks, automations, and the local host server from your terminal or from CI.
launch agents with a prompt, open terminals, and track tasks from another agent or script via the Superset MCP server
Superset MCP server: create Git-worktree workspaces, launch coding-agent sessions
